summary.plain: The Mark II detector: a solenoidal general-purpose detector that moved from SPEAR to PEP and then to the SLC, where it was the first detector to see Z boson decays at a linear collider.
summary.technical: Mark II detector, a general-purpose solenoidal detector that began life at SPEAR, moved to PEP, was upgraded and then installed on the SLC.
